title: Dynamic Shaping: Acquiring Interfaces and Constructing Execution over Frozen Pretrained Components
abstract: arXiv:2611.20573v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We introduce Dynamic Shaping, a method for constructing executable neural arrangements through acquired response and partial-derivative interfaces over frozen pretrained components. The method learns local descriptions of available computation, ranks component rebindings using task-gradient alignment, transports the current interface across a rebinding, and retains changes through behavioral feedback. Continuous interface acquisition uses proximal policy optimization; the source coefficients remain fixed. We derive an exact identity relating transport error in component responses and partials to changes in action logits and their sensitivities. A pixels-only ViZDoom Basic study evaluates first task acquisition without a competent reference controller, demonstrations or intact response targets. translated_title: 动态塑形：在冻结的预训练组件上获取接口并构建执行
translated_abstract: 我们提出动态塑形（Dynamic Shaping），这是一种通过在冻结的预训练组件上获取响应与偏导数接口来构建可执行神经组合的方法。该方法学习可用计算的局部描述，利用任务梯度对齐对组件重绑定进行排序，在重绑定过程中传输当前接口，并通过行为反馈保留变化。连续接口获取采用近端策略优化（PPO），而源系数保持固定。我们推导出一个精确恒等式，将组件响应与偏导数中的传输误差与动作logits及其敏感度的变化联系起来。一项仅使用像素输入的ViZDoom Basic研究评估了在缺乏合格参考控制器、示范数据或完整响应目标的情况下的首次任务获取能力。在三次初始化和100个共享保留游戏种子上，初始组合在86/300个控制器/回合对上取得成功；联合接口-（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出动态塑形方法，通过学习冻结预训练组件上的响应与偏导数接口，利用任务梯度对齐进行重绑定排序并用近端策略优化实现接口的连续获取与传输，在仅有像素输入且无参考控制器、示范或完整响应目标的ViZDoom任务中实现了首次任务获取。
en_tdlr: Dynamic Shaping constructs executable neural arrangements by acquiring response and partial-derivative interfaces over frozen pretrained components, ranking rebindings via task-gradient alignment and using proximal policy optimization for interface acquisition and transport, achieving first-task acquisition on pixels-only ViZDoom without any reference controller, demonstrations, or intact response targets.
